result.keyword: What's the best e-signature software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For a small business, my overall recommendation would be **Dropbox Sign or DocuSign**, depending on how many documents you send and how much you want to spend.

If you're a UK-based small business, I'd also seriously consider **Signable**, which is a UK-based alternative with straightforward pricing.

Here's how I'd compare the leading options in 2026.

## Best e-signature software compared

![PandaDoc Review: Sign, Seal, Deliver](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/0MUKV24vOJ8Fy84anuzrEeDfSf0kpDjVQFizvzFH_No27CWsxijbo2OMMlOGpvgS85vZB3wg04yrL3uUEA8HfUdyjeWSSz3aH8VUzmHL1gINYfR2lzt9WJR1seELOV2zEpePqA9WPggyXDEs9xtNtG6ptm3fJ7rmZx4q6N4W7fYpmzjZfQx9dTipSbsTdrj3?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign**

(Best for most small businesses)

# From \~£12/month

- Very easy to use.
- Reusable document templates.
- Signing reminders and tracking.
- Good Google Drive and Dropbox integrations.

Best if you want something straightforward without unnecessary complexity.

[Visit Dropbox Sign](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

**2\. DocuSign**

(Best overall functionality)

# From \~£8/month

- Widely recognised by customers.
- Excellent audit trails.
- Lots of integrations.
- Advanced signing workflows.

Best if you regularly send contracts to clients, suppliers or employees.

[Visit DocuSign](https://www.docusign.com/en-gb)

---

![Signable - Sales Enablement and E-Signature App for HubSpot | Signable](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/gGvZ428-QbTIsXWx5S3s4zb6kZDelI9e6ZN1kcrVXolj1eCD-CGWYpJUWQVhaaNegb8o5414_h9QprmHzoP6h5tK6DtY4aVvKfnST-Ll6yIMrl8U2ytx_iGlhlJQGLqoqEbDe6PtiDf5VDUiYl3n5stFymYFaK57eWdPcCBx7o-QM2JljTdOAGcEYS_3vHeI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Signable**

(Best UK small-business option)

# From \~£31/month

- UK-based provider.
- Unlimited users on its account-based plans.
- Pay-as-you-go options.
- Simple document templates and signing workflows.

Particularly attractive if several employees need to send documents.

[Visit Signable](https://www.signable.co.uk/)

---

![PandaDoc Logo Vector Image Download | Logowik](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ymPhVTd1UiEfhLv-1RRaBHzfc7w_X9GAy3-oA-Iq6aUpRSw-pMKFwzWhxDcdxLIJO09S6CJuUtYhl8cmdLzAbQ1bPaqfusyAUINVqBofOkizhPaQKQUsU_wbDixAs7-HQb_7Ny2ZWhfcmx4hraN3WElI4ZwqgL69LX40yhPrytGXQRQVchRZiNftn-ec17ix?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. PandaDoc**

# From \~£15–£20/month equivalent

- Create professional proposals and quotes.
- Add pricing tables and payment options.
- Track when customers view documents.
- Electronic signatures included.

Best if your business sends lots of sales proposals and quotations.

[Visit PandaDoc](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

---

![Adobe Acrobat Sign Solutions for business Transaction New](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/boFV63978924LtJqDW6sL1JIitAIaS-BthRNk192q0PHK-HvHdZBMxqDjDCO72LE2oPF1ayxecsE94Q-YPvxHO-S7Mi38P9TmXNhPAUlm7-8leU4NJBCSUCriipzFK7eQRBF1P54X7oN4viJGvAqlvPFeHJwJMDSU5H8EIj-uBFDS8q0gO8ZF29lIfJEU-lB?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Adobe Acrobat Sign**

# From \~£15/month

- Excellent PDF functionality.
- Integrates with Adobe Acrobat.
- Document editing and signing.
- Good for businesses already using Adobe.

Best if most of your business paperwork is PDF-based.

[Visit Adobe Acrobat Sign](https://www.adobe.com/uk/acrobat/business/sign.html)

Prices are indicative UK starting prices or approximate equivalents, not guaranteed live quotes. Plans, VAT and document limits vary.

## My recommendation

| Your business needs | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| Simple client contracts | Dropbox Sign |
| Professional, established platform | DocuSign |
| Several employees sending contracts | Signable |
| Quotes and sales proposals | PandaDoc |
| Editing and signing PDFs | Adobe Sign |


One important point: check that your chosen plan includes an audit trail, document authentication, reusable templates and sufficient monthly signature requests.

For UK businesses, also check that the signing process meets the appropriate requirements under UK electronic-signature law, particularly if you're signing deeds or other formal documents.
